newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ policy focusing on recovery - Matsushita quoted.
newsitem.headline: BOJ policy focusing on recovery - Matsushita quoted.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said the central bank would focus its monetary policy for now on making the basis for economic recovery sturdier, the Yomiuri Shimbun daily reported on Tuesday.
In an interview with the Yomiuri, Matsushita also said the Japanese economy had shown a mild recovery and become firmer.

"Our monetary policy for the time being is to continue focusing on boosting the foundation of economic recovery," Matsushita told the daily. "We also want to watch prices carefully, because falls in prices have begun to halt since the end of last year."

Asked when the central bank will start debating a change in its current easy money policy, Matsushita said: "We do not have a view on when to start discussing it. We will watch the economic climate and market conditions carefully."
The BOJ chief said an improved job situation and wages should cushion any adverse impact on consumption of an April 1 rise in the sales tax.
